name: Triathletes on Zwift Saturday Endurance Workout
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This workout is part of a 30-week progressive series that builds from tempo to sub threshold focused workout efforts.  The aim of this series is to build riders long ride aerobic abilities, specifically to enable them to effectively get off the bike prepared to run.  Total ride time over the 24 build series weeks will extend from 1hr :15 min up to 3 hours.  As workouts get longer we will incorporate higher effort/shorter duration intervals (super threshold work) into the program after the main set.  These workouts are perfect for long course focused triathletes along with anyone interested in developing their abilities to ride for longer periods of time.  Each of the 24-week workouts builds off the preceding workout in terms of duration of main set intervals and total ride time.

WORKOUT DESIGNER

AJ Baucco is a well established professional triathlete from Cleveland, Ohio. He founded AJ Baucco Coaching, which has coached over 150 triathletes in the last 5 years. He also manages 3 different age group triathlon teams; The Baucco Squad, TRS Racing, and Team INFINIT Performance. Over the years, AJ Baucco has become a premier triathlon coach. He has helped athletes achieve personal bests, stand on podiums, and even race world championship events. On the race course, AJ Baucco has achieved top results at every distance from super sprint to Ironman. Most recently, he was on the winning team for 6 different Major League Triathlon events, and 2 back to back series championships.

Contact – 
Websites – www.baucco.com, www.ajbcoaching.com, www.bauccosquad.com
Twitter - @irunshirtless
Instagram - @ajbaucco

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins.  Everyone stays together regardless of power output.   That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other.  Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.   

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

chasing you down. Start times are set so they can catch you in the final
segments.

Pen E is the advertised paced ride with beacons
Pen D is a 85 min pace (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen C is the 50 minute pace chase (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen B is the 45 minute pace chase (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen A is the sub 40 minute pace (beacons not guaranteed)

Alpe Paced Rides

Wanna build your Alpe pace but want a wheel to follow?
Join our rides where our beacons will pace you at 4 different advertised
paces across 4 rolling weekends, 2 paces per weekend at 8am CT and 9.30 am CT.

Hold pace until ya crack, then come back again and get to extend the
cracking point.

We deliver Personal Records / Bests.

The goal is to build up to the magic sub 60 mins for Alpe, faster and
slower riders are always welcome.

This is a rolling 4-week schedule

Weekend #1
8.00 am CT 60 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 75 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #2
8.00 am CT 65 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 70 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #3
8.00 am CT 70 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 65 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #4
8.00 am CT 75 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 60 min pace - Team GIANT

Pro tips

1) Look at your best Alpe time on Strava, there will be a segment for
the entire
climb with average watts for the entire climb. Beating that average
watts number
by 5 watts each segment is your goal for each segment.

2) Use all the tools in the toolbox:
• Cardiovascular = Seated higher rpm
• Legs = Seated low rpm – Great for the knees!!!!
• Legs = Standing low rpm – You will crack

3) We go warm for the first 25%, a steady pace for the until 75% and push at
the end, start out too hot and you’ll suffer at the top.

name: CCBoucherville-V2000 FUN Races
description:
Club Cycliste Boucherville (CCB) in Quebec (Canada) is a non-profit organization to promote cycling as a social and healthy lifestyle. We help kids to acquire the knowledge and skills that will allow to develop themselves as cyclists. Although we prioritize the pleasure at training, we also make sure to support those who wish to participate in races, regardless of the objectives. Young riders can join us from the age of 5... as long as they want to have fun on two wheels. The first year, we can even provide them with a bike for free - thanks to Vélo-2000 Garneau Concept (https://velo2000.qc.ca/)).

This weekly race is meant to be an opportunity to ride and have fun with teammates and opponents during the cold season, and meet passionate cyclists from around the world.

Race your category (based on your best estimation of your FTP/kg).

- A: 4.0W/kg and OVER (Red Circle Icon)  --  3 laps
- B: 3.2W/kg to 3.99W/kg (Green Circle Icon)  --  3 laps
- C: 2.5W/kg to 3.19W/kg (Blue Circle Icon)  --  2 laps
- D: UNDER 2.5W/kg (Yellow Circle Icon)  --  1 lap

Be prepared for 1, 2 or 3 laps (around 10 km each). The course is relatively flat. Start strong and grab a good wheel.

All bikes allowed

PowerUp allowed

Heart Rate Monitor recommended

Unfair and unsporting behaviour prohibited

Fun and Lactate mandatory

Results will be available here and on zwiftpower.com. These races do not count towards any league standings.

Join us on our Discord Channel (https://discord.gg/DZDVFVhto) to discuss your race strategy during the warm-up… and chat during the race if you have enough energy. Use the GENERAL channel, or discuss more privately with your Bike Club teammates in your respective channel. Welcome to French- and English-speaking riders. Please use push-to-talk. 

Please visit our website https://clubcyclisteboucherville.com/ and our FaceBook page https://www.facebook.com/clubcyclisteboucherville/ to share pictures, comments and suggestions.

Ride Hard. Have Fun.

#sympatique #CCB #velo2000 #FunRace

description:

You’ll head into next season with more strength, endurance, and power than base miles alone can give you, and you’ll build it on two focused one-hour rides a week. Tuesday and Thursday are the quality sessions. When work or life gets in the way, Saturday is your make-up day, so a busy week doesn’t cost you the progress.

This is the first 9 weeks of Endurance Nation’s OutSeason cycling series, and it’s not an experiment. More than 10,000 cyclists and triathletes have used it over the last 20 years to show up in the spring faster than they left in the fall.

Spend this winter on targeted work and see what it does for your next season. Learn more at www.endurancenation.us/outseason.

Welcome to the ZLDR Weekly Long Run. ZLDR is a group of diverse runners, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners who will make sure that you are never left behind.

This distance of this run changes depending on the week. For most Saturdays, the event distance will be 13.1 miles/21.1 km. On the first Saturday of every month our run will go to 26.2 miles / 42.2 km -- that’s a full marathon. We keep this run on routes that are faily short loops so that everyone can stay within chat distance of each other no matter what speed you are running or walking.

Of course, as with all of our runs, you are not required to go the entire distance listed. Feel free to run as long as you would like, but as a distance running group we like to offer our members a chance every month to put their legs to the test and see how far they can go.

For more ZLDR fun and support, join our groups on social media platforms:

Facebook group:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZLDR2020
Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/zldr.2020/
Strava:
https://www.strava.com/clubs/zldr2020
Discord Invitation (not required for the run)
https://discord.com/invite/PuFctEnWyn

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Castle Crit
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: DIRT Dadurday Chase Race
description:
Welcome to the DIRT Dadurday Chase Race.

Race category starts will be staggered with the E category starting first, and each D, C, B, and A category starting later.

The riders will be challenged to work together using the draft, and group tactics in order to catch the category ahead of them while also holding off the categories that started after. 

Races will have 4 power-ups enabled with equal odds (25% each): 
draft, feather, burrito, & ghost! 
Compete with the best, and see how you stack up!

You must be opted-in on Zwift.com & ZwiftPower.com to be counted for race results.
We highly encourage A racers to follow Zwift eRacing Ruleset.
Dual recording of trainer & power meter, and recent weigh-in on ZwifTransparency 
recommended--we reserve the right to ask for this information to verify outstanding 
performances.

Categories are based on Zwift Racing Score:
A: 800 - 1000
B: 600 - 800
C: 400 - 600
D: 200 - 400
E: 0 - 200

name: Team CLS Base 'n' Banter
description:
Base ’n’ Banter is a controlled weekend endurance ride - with a strong community and social focus! 

Across every weekend in 2026, we will continue to offer a mix of rides that cover flat, rolling and hilly terrain with the aim of getting in a solid endurance ride, mostly around 2hrs.

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced group club ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. While you build your fitness, there is always plenty of in-ride banter. 

What pace to expect?
We will ride the flats around 2.5 - 2.7 w/kg with a focus on keeping everyone together!

The leader will climb at around 3.0 - 3.2 w/kg depending on the length and if needed we will always try and regroup after.

While the leader will do everything to keep everyone together, we can't slow repeatedly so some splits are inevitable.

Our SWEEPERS on this ride, known as our ‘ORANGE ARMY’ (OA), are members of TEAM CLS who are dedicated to helping others. If you have had a drop out or accidentally hit a wrong key, type ‘HELP’ and they will come back and offer you a wheel back to the group.

Note: While we always try to ensure this ride is led by one of our beacons there may be some weeks where this is not possible. The ride always has regulars that will ride to the advertised pace!


WEEKLY PROGRAM
Mon  18:50 UK - Team CLS Racing - Pace ‘n’ Race: Recon and Activation 
Tues 18:50 UK - This ‘n’ That - Endurance Training
Wed  18:50 UK - Ride ‘n’ Explore Club Rideout
Thur 18:50 UK - High ‘n’ Low - Interval Training
Sat  08:50 and 14:45 UK - Base ‘n’ Banter Endurance ride
Sun  18:50 UK - Chill 'n' Spin - Weekend Social

Check out www.teamclscc.co.uk ...find out about our club, current events and leaders.

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that no riders ride off the front of the group. The event is designed as part of 3R’s package of #ProStyleTraining events to assist with the attainment of your training goals and may include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

name: SISU Movember
description:
This November, join SISU Racing as we come together for a race with an important purpose – raising awareness for men's health.

The challenge is simple! Start November 1st clean-shaven, grow a magnificent (or magnificently terrible!) moustache, get moving and, most importantly, spark conversations that matter.

Movember focuses on three important areas: Prostate Cancer Testicular Cancer Mental Health and Suicide Prevention.

At SISU Racing, we believe in the power of human connection. Sometimes, a simple conversation can make a world of difference.

The Race
Cirque du Suffer, Paris
Every Saturday in November

Whether you're sporting a glorious handlebar moustache, struggling with a few whiskers or simply joining us for the race, everyone is welcome!

Learn more about Movember at sisu.racing/movember and join the conversation on the SISU Racing Discord.

Let’s race and talk about men's health

name: NoPinz R3R - 60km Race
description:
Welcome to this NoPinz R3R Race. The rules are simple....
Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.
Cats A, and B will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor.
Cat C will require power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor for podium spots.
Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual (power) record and to make analysis publicly available on ZwiftPower; they must also be using a direct drive trainer or power meter.

Please also maintain an open and active Strava profile to facilitate organiser inquiry.

name: Alpe 70 min Pace 😈🍍
description:
As Zwift is a great community Torturefest Cult & Team GIANT are collaborating
to help you get stronger.

Wanna build your Alpe pace but want a wheel to follow?
Join our rides where our beacons will pace you at 4 different advertised paces across 4 rolling weekends, 2 paces per weekend at 8am CT and 9.30am CT.

We do have unofficial slower and faster paces just ask in the pen and if we have available pacers we will pace a 2nd pace as well.

Hold pace until ya crack, then come back again and get to extend the cracking point. 
We deliver Personal Records / Bests.

The goal is to build up to the magic sub 60 mins for Alpe, faster and slower riders are always welcome.

This is a rolling 4-week schedule 

Weekend #1
8.00 am CT 60 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 75 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #2
8.00 am CT 65 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 70 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #3
8.00 am CT 70 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 65 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #4
8.00 am CT 75 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 60 min pace - Team GIANT


Pro tips

1) Look at your best Alpe time on Strava, there will be a segment for the
entire climb with average watts for the entire climb. Beating that average watt
number by 5 watts each segment is your goal for each segment.

2) Use all the tools in the toolbox:

• Cardiovascular = Seated higher rpm

• Legs = Seated low rpm – Great for the knees!!!!

• Legs = Standing low rpm – You will crack

3) We go warm for the first 25%, a steady pace for the until 75% and push
at the end, start out to hot you’ll suffer at the top.

name: Fearless & Fabulous Social Spin
description:
Looking for a relaxed, social ride with great company? Join Team Fearless for a fun ladies-only group ride! 🌸

We’ll roll together at a nice pace — perfect for chatting, enjoying the scenery, and spinning those legs. Whether you’re new to Zwift or a seasoned rider, this is a great way to start the week with a dose of motivation and community.

Hop on Discord (Fearless and Fans Social Rides voice channel) to join the conversation and laughter — the miles will fly by before you know it! 🎧💬

https://discord.gg/GQwdtep

Come ride, connect, and celebrate the power of women on wheels. 💪💖

About Team Fearless:

Founded in 2017, Team Fearless is the first all-women Zwift team — built on fun, friendship, and fitness.

name: GXY SUMMITS & SWITCHBACKS
description:
SUMMITS AND SWITCHBACKS is a weekly social spin that targets the more undulating courses on Zwift and staying in the draft is essential on these type of courses for this event 

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- C
Power 	- 2.3 > 3.0wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.65wkg based on a 75kg rider.
Fence 	- Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion
Draft	- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group
Sweeper     - Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name

ETHOS 

We at GXY are committed to creating a culture of belonging, inclusivity and compassion empowering people to grow stronger, work together and support one another to achieve shared success on Zwift

GXY – Here together, for you 💜

If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or both, please come and join ideally via our Facebook link:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/galaxycyclingclub/
https://www.strava.com/clubs/989894
https://www.instagram.com/galaxycyclingclub

name: PACK🐺 SUB2 + After Party
description:
This PACK SUB2 event is aimed at Zwifters looking for a friendly group ride experience with a pace that matches the description of less than 2w/kg. It’s a great introduction to group riding with full pace instructions via text and voice chat using discord. You can sign up early via the web or mobile app and late join is enabled.

After the event finishes, there is an optional fun After Party challenge normally up the final climb. Help pace others or try to beat your HoloReplay.

All riders will appear in the same kit and you can optionally add (PACK) after your name to show support of the group. Please respect the pace set by the leader, this is a group ride not a race. #strongertogether

Finally, if you are just starting your zwift experience, please join our facebook group and PACK Club for tips on group riding, friendly advice and to answer any questions you have.

name: Bicycle Way of Life Saturday Ride
description:
Bicycle Way of Life Saturday Morning 100K

This group ride is not a race, rather it is a ride intended as a D level opportunity for a metric century.  Our pace can best be described as endurance pace, typically on a relatively flat course.  We always plan to provide lead and sweep support, but there will be times where that will not be the case.  You are encouraged to pace with the ride leader/yellow beacon, but if they are not able to make the ride, or if you find the pace too quick, drop off, group up, work together and find your way to 100K.  Teamwork makes this ride work.
 
Want to know more about us? Bicycle Way of Life (bicycleway.com) is a local bike store chain in Eugene, Oregon. We encourage new and experienced riders to support each other indoors and out, fixing trails or just their bikes.
Interact and find more info. by joining our FB group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bwolzwift
Look us up on Strava https://www.strava.com/clubs/bicycleway-com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/bicyclewayoflife/, and Facebook https://www.facebook.com/bicycleway/

name: The HERD Rehab Ride
description:
This is a banded ride so the group can stay together and support riders new to Zwift, or recovering from sickness, or injuries. The ride leader, the Yellow Beacon, will ride at the advertised pace and, unless you stop pedaling, the group will stay together as if held together by a rubber band. Those wishing to ride faster/harder may certainly do so but THIS IS NOT A RACE! We ride together as a Herd. Clean "Dad Jokes" are encouraged!
Have fun.

eventSubgroups.name: The HERD Rehab Ride (D)
eventSubgroups.description:

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/Dr7ZtPV (Please use Push-To-Talk)

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: Team Italy Burn Calories Together!
description:
Team Italy – Burning Calories Together is a welcoming social group ride where we keep things fun and supportive. The lead yellow beacon sets a steady pace between 1.5–2.0 w/kg and keeps the group together using the fence. Our sweeper also carries a yellow beacon to ensure all messages of help and encouragement are clearly visible to every rider. Together our ride leaders, supported by ITA friends, make sure no one is left behind.
It’s a relaxed atmosphere with plenty of friendly chat where riders look out for each other. Whether you’re building fitness, spinning the legs, or just enjoying good company, this ride is for everyone — so come share the fun and burn calories together!

Team Italy – Burning Calories Together è una pedalata di gruppo sociale e accogliente, pensata per divertirsi e sostenersi a vicenda. Il leader, con beacon giallo, mantiene un’andatura costante tra 1,5 e 2,0 w/kg e tiene il gruppo compatto utilizzando la fence. Anche lo sweeper avrà il Beacon giallo, così tutti i messaggi di aiuto e incoraggiamento saranno chiaramente visibili a ogni partecipante. Insieme, i nostri leader, supportati dagli amici ITA, faranno in modo che nessuno venga lasciato indietro.
L’atmosfera sarà rilassata, con una chat piacevole, e i ciclisti si prenderanno cura gli uni degli altri. Che tu stia migliorando la forma fisica, sciogliendo le gambe o semplicemente godendoti la buona compagnia, questa pedalata è per tutti — quindi vieni a condividere il divertimento e a bruciare calorie insieme!

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 40K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Castle Crit
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Alpe | Week 5
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Rollers Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Rollers Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Surrey
description:
PACK Beginner Hill Training is a group workout designed to help runners get familiar with running with incline. This is a free run event meaning there is no set pace you must go, but there will be incline prompts that attempt to mimic the terrain of the course. The inclines are based on distance, so you will always be given prompts based on your progression in the workout. If some of the gradients are too challenging for you, feel free to decrease the incline, but don't make it too easy. The leader will typically follow the pace chart below, but may adjust depending on the group dynamics.

Note: We will not always be matching Zwift gradients, so it is important to pay attention to the instructions. Typically the adjusted incline will be half of what is being displayed in the upper righthand corner.

As a general guide: 
--------------------------
0 - 1% = 10.2kph / 6.3 mph
2% - 9.9 kph / 6.2 mph
3% = 9.7 kph / 6.0 mph
4% = 9.3 kph / 5.8 mph 
5% = 9 kph / 5.6 mph
6% = 8.7 kph / 5.4 mph
7% = 7.4 kph / 5.2 mph
--------------------------

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation in the fit file, you'll need to either have a direct connect treadmill or use an app like Pascal's Runcline for iOS, TSS app for iOS, or Runn module from North Pole Engineering.

Finally, if the hills don't wear you out, there will be an optional 500 meter sprint to the finish and optional after party of 2-4km to boot!

So put PACK in your name, get your black shirt and shorts on, and let's tackle those hills!

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

name: Herd Classics #4 - Bullseye Points Race
description:
Herd Classics: six weeks, six different races.

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.
Take on legendary Zwift courses while going on a trip down memory lane. Each week brings
us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: JETT Endurance Ride 100km 2.5~3.3w/kg
description:
JETT Endurance Ride !!
Let's ride 2.5w/kg~3.3w/kg !!
B category's average of power is 3.0~3.3w/kg, start is 2.5w/kg for grouping.
C category's average of power is 2.5~2.9w/kg, start is 2.0w/kg for grouping.

Double draft is on.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Keep stay around Yellow Beacon
· TT Bike is allowed but TT bike cant get drafting effect.
· If you exceed the Fence, return to Yellow Beacon at 2.0w/kg or less.

*There are several Sweepers on this group ride. If you have dropped, please
request 'Help' in ZWIFT Chat if you need help. A sweeper goes for help.
However, we can not help without the offer of 'HElp'.

Follow endurance ride for 2 hours and 30 minutes, follow leader
instructions and enjoy ZWIFT chat, let's work together and make the best
group, the best workout!

※Please note that we will flag you if you lead at abnormal speed.

JETT Endurance Ride
休日の朝を100kmを2.5w/kg~3.3w/kgでライドしましょう！
B categoryの平均パワーは、3.0~3.3w/kgです。スタートは2.5w/kgでグルーピングします。
C categoryの平均パワーは、2.5~2.9w/kgです。スタートは2.0w/kgでグルーピングします。

ダブルドラフトはオンです。

このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること
・Yellow Beaconから離れないでライドしましょう
・TT Bikeは使用可能ですが、Drafting効果を得られません。
・Fenceをオーバーした場合は、2.0w/kg以下でYellow Beaconまで戻りましょう。

*このグループライドにはスイーパーが何名かいます。もし，ドロップしてしまった時，支援が必要な時はZWIFT
Chatで'Help'と申し出てください。スイーパーが助けに行きます。しかし，'HElp’の申し出がない限り助けには行けません。
2時間30分の耐久ライド、リーダー指示に従い、またZWIFTチャットを楽しみながら、みんなで協力し最高のグループ、最高のワークアウトにしましょう！

※異常なスピードでリードした場合、あなたにフラグを立てますので注意して下さい。

#jett #japan

description: **Please sign up at www.ZwiftPower.com if you want your results to be visible at www.runinthepark.co.uk The Original Zwift Group Run** **This event is a 5km mass start and is scheduled at multiple times every Saturday. name: Tiny Race (1 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Glasgow Crit Circuit (2 laps - 6.3km) - Powerup: Anvil
Race 2: Bell Lap (3 laps - 5.7km) - Powerup: Feather
Race 3: Downtown Dolphin (3 laps, 5.7km) - Powerup:  Draft 
Race 4: Neokyo Crit Course (1 lap - 4.7km) - Powerup: Aero

PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172
- Zone 2 (3pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1173
- Zone 3 (9pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1174

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 40K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: Paceline Work
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This is a great workout for mimicking the demands of working in a paceline. Although gravel events feature mainly off-road and gnarly terrain, they also typically have asphalt and smoother dirt roads. Being able to stay in and work with a group as the speed inevitably increases over this terrain is crucial to achieve maximum speed due to the aerodynamic advantage gained.

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Shayne Gaffney (GC Coaching) holds a bachelors degree in Health Science in Professional Development and Advanced Patient Care, is a USA Cycling Level 1 (expert level) Certified Coach, a level 2 certified Training Peaks coach, a USA Cycling certified power based training coach, USA Olympic Committee Safe Sport Certified, and a licensed physical therapist assistant.  He is also the creator of Zwift's "Build Me Up" Flexible Training Plan.  He can be contacted directly via  for any cycling or training related questions.

For more information on GC Coaching, please visit www.gaffneycyclingcoaching.com

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Alpe | Week 5
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

description:

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.

us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Alpe | Week 5
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: The Zombie 5k
description:
Brought to you from the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) this event is called the Zombie Run as for those in the UK this event is in the middle of the night.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.
If you don't want to run 5k then come along for as long as you wish, the support is always appreciated.
The event runs at the same time each day, Tuesday to Saturday and each day there is a different course.

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.

name: INC Summer Endurance Ride Series
description:
INC Winter Endurance Ride – Sundays 5:30 AM (CET) 

 Do you measure rides in days, not hours? 
Do you know what it means to push through the night – chasing the horizon, legs on autopilot, mind in flow? 


Then welcome to the tribe. The Winter Endurance Ride is a steady, social endurance session for everyone who rides far – really far. This ride is for:  Randonneurs & Brevet riders who think 600k is just getting started, Transcontinental racers & ultra-distance addicts who live for the long haul, Bikepackers & 24-hour riders who know the beauty (and the madness) of riding through fatigue.  

And everyone else who just wants to challenge themselves with a solid 2–5 hour endurance session. We roll steady at 2.7–3.1 W/kg for 2–5 hours – no surges, no chaos, just that perfect endurance rhythm. The goal: build endurance, build mental strength, and share the mindset that defines true long-distance riders. 

 We talk routes, gear, sleep strategies, and the art of suffering with style. Whether you’re training for the next TCR, a 1200k brevet, or just want to ride steady with people who get it – this is your place. Ride steady. Ride far. Ride together. The long game starts here.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

The Hotchillee Race, Ride or Conquer ride is a series of Sunday morning endurance focussed races/rides that are a perfect way to get in a solid endurance session.

The routes will typically be in the 70-120 mins range but we might throw in some longer ones too.

The idea, just like a good sportive, is, no matter what your pace, you should find some wheels to ride with and, with double-draft enabled, should be able to hang on and tick that route off.

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

description:
Het is Koers, the famous Dutch cycling blog presents you a variety of social rides. At Sunday morning we go "in the Dutch Mountains"

Meaning a ride leader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.

name: Rowe & King - Fire Breather
description:
This is a group ride, with a difference! It will be 80 minutes, with the final 10 minutes a free for all race to the last second! 

The format of the ride is as follows;
10 Minutes easy as a warm up
20 Minutes ramped effort, to 85% of FTP
5 Minutes easy
3 x (20s Max effort sprint - 3 Minutes easy)
20 Minutes ramp down from 85% of FTP
10 Minutes full gas race

name: 60-200km Audax - Jet Squad Base Gamechanger
description:
An opportunity you don’t want to miss!

Audax is our friendly, long-distance endurance group ride designed to build a strong aerobic base for the upcoming season. This is where we develop metabolic efficiency, improve our ability to use fat as fuel, and build stronger, more resilient mitochondria.

We ride in a tight, efficient group to maximize speed and minimize energy expenditure. We support each other, work together, and help bring riders back into the group when they get dropped.

Our routes are mainly flat, with a few short kickers to keep things interesting and the intensity up.

Flyers are NOT welcome! If you decide to attack, surge, or ride off the front, don’t expect the group to chase you. You will be skipped by the leaders. This is endurance training, not a race.

STYLE

The ride is led by The Jet (coach) or a designated deputy, depending on the current training schedule.

You’ll ride alongside athletes from The Jet Squad, including professional athletes and strong Kona-level age-group triathletes building their aerobic base for the upcoming season.

Distances will increase throughout each training block according to the squad’s training plans. Riders may leave the group at different points to match their individual schedules.

Expect structure, teamwork, discipline, and plenty of kilometers added to your books.

WHO CAN JOIN?

Everyone who wants to go beyond standard winter training and build a strong foundation for the next season.

Triathletes, cyclists, hand cyclists, and other endurance enthusiasts are all welcome.

Be realistic about your current fitness level: these rides are demanding, and you may need to build up gradually over several sessions to stay with the group all the way to the finish.

Come ready to work. Leave stronger.

WHEN

Usually Saturday and Sunday early mornings (CET).

Check the event announcement for the latest schedules, routes, distances and details.

PACING

Front group targets:

Flat roads: 2.8–3.2 W/kg
Climbs: 3.0–4.8 W/kg
The coach may adjust these targets depending on the purpose of the session and the current training block.

Slower groups will naturally form behind the front group. Ride at a pace that allows you to train effectively and sustainably.

THE TARGET: LIGHTSPEED, NOT CHAOS!

The mission is simple: fast, steady, and controlled from start to finish.

No over pacing in the first half.
No unnecessary surges.
No power drop-off in the final kilometers.
No ego-driven attacks.
We ride as a group, maintain a consistent rhythm, and work together to keep the speed high.

Save your matches. You’ll need them later.

You will suffer. Just wait for it.

NUTRITION & BREAKS

Preparation starts well before the ride.

You are responsible for your own nutrition and hydration. Plan ahead and bring enough fuel to cover the full distance.

Hydration: As a starting point, plan for at least 1 liter of fluid per hour, adjusted to your sweat rate, indoor conditions, and individual needs. Include electrolytes.
Carbohydrates: Bring enough carbs to fuel the session according to its intensity, duration, and your nutrition strategy.
Backup supplies: Carry an additional bottle and spare nutrition, such as bananas, energy bars, or gels.
Metabolic training: Some sessions may provide an opportunity to practice riding with lower carbohydrate availability, but this must be planned and appropriate to the session. Don’t confuse under fueling with effective training.
Fuel smart. Ride strong. Finish strong.

THE GOAL

Cover the planned distance as quickly as possible while maintaining a steady, sustainable effort throughout the entire ride.

We are building the engine for next season: aerobic endurance, metabolic efficiency, pacing discipline, and group-riding skills.

The goal isn’t to win the first 50 km. It’s to finish the full distance strong.

AUDAX – THE MYTH

Audax is a long-distance cycling discipline in which participants aim to complete a defined route within a specified time limit. Traditionally, it emphasizes endurance, self-sufficiency, and completion rather than racing against other riders.

The roots of Audax go back to Italian endurance events in the late nineteenth century, with formal rules subsequently developed in France.

Learn more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audax

ENJOY THE RIDE. EMBRACE THE DISTANCE. BUILD THE ENGINE.

THE JET SQUAD

name: Fishalicious does new routes! 🦈
description:
Join the Fishalicious banded ride for fun that's off the scale - NEW route special! 

Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group, if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the "rubber-band" activated, which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up, and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast, and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.

The ride speed may be slightly less than other group rides due to the rubber band effect, but that's a small price to pay to allow riders of all levels to remain together throughout the ride. We are all about teamwork, working together as a group, and we look forward to riding with you!

Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: WELCOME TO THE BRAUNSTEIN CYCLING CLUB DANISH GROUP RIDE
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

name: Watts More To the Top!
description:
Watts More! Ride with friends in challenging events. Take on your challenge in Watts, elevation or duration! 

At Sunday morning we go To the top! A rideleader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob. During the season we build up the elevation meters. 

From October until March these rides are guided with a rideleader. From April until September the rides are without rideleader. In that case don’t argue, blob up and be nice.  
 
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the Watts More Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/1151203888657006/?ref=share 

 Join Watts More on Zwift  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/d6afeaa7-e754-478a-b68d-2a794648fa02/home  

 
Other Watts More events: 
Build more Watts! (C) 2.5-3.0 W/kg, Tuesday 19.00 CET  
Different Watts! (D) 2.2-2.4 W/kg, Thursday 19.00 CET 
Rendurance! (C) 2.2-2.6 W/kg, Saturday 9.00 AM CET

name: Vikings Valhalla Sunday Skaal ride
description:
Welcome to the Vikings Valhalla Sunday Skaal ride. 

We would love to have you join us to toast a ride together to end the week. Our rides are very inclusive with a ‘’no one gets dropped’’ approach. We encourage riders to respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back. Come and try us..

name: SZR Groupworkouts by Aktivitus
description:
These WOs are designed to give you improved aerobic development and increased aerobic threshold (LT1) -endurance - in a 2h workout. To get most out of this session, make sure your FTP is correct set. If you are aerobic underdeveloped for cycling you may need to decrease your FTP-settings.

The workout is 120min and starts with a 15min warmup. First main block is 3x15min at a controlled threshold/Sweet spot (90% of FTP) on lower cadences to wear us down and to get a time effective local aerobic development and cycling strength (endurance).

The second block contains 20x30/60sek intervals. 30sec at 150% of FTP with a 1min active rest. This is highly anaerobic which gives us an improved lactic tolerance and an increased anaerobic stanima. However, in a worn-out state these intervals will also stress your aerobic development. That means you oxygen transport into your working muscles will get better. Your endurance will thereby increase.

This WO is designed Johan Hasselmark at Aktivitus (www.aktivitus.se). Aktivitus runs Swedens leading test and coaching operations for endurance sports.
Johan Hasselmark is an international level adventure racer and extreme triathlete with several wins, 30 years of competative experince in endurance sports and 8 years of coaching and physiological testing.

name: Norwegian Watts Club Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to Norwegian Watts Endurance Ride

When it’s getting cold and wet outside, it’s time to get inside and get the hours in. Join us for a chill and kind spirited century ride. You don’t have to stay for the whole ride, but all finishers will be rewarded our awesome jersey.

The aim is to keep the group together, chatting and having
fun. This is a group ride, not a race!

Pace 1,7-2,1 w/kg

The ride leader will aim to ride mid parameters, but there might be slight variations above or below the average during the ride.

NB:
Please always respect the ride leader and follow his/her
instructions.

name: ZZRC Wacky Chase
description:
Welcome to ZZRC’s Wacky Chase!

Get ready to saddle up for an unforgettable adventure that combines pace, fun, and a dash of friendly competition! Our group rides are open to all riders, and we’ve constructed a delightful two paced category to ensure everyone can enjoy a safe and top-notch experience on two wheels.

Here’s the game plan: we’ve divided our crew into two spirited teams. Team B will zoom at a snappy 3.2-3.8 pace, Team C will enjoy a smooth cruise at 2.4-2.8. We’re throwing in a twist of excitement with a hot chase. Team C takes off first from the pen, followed swiftly by Team B.

This isn’t just another group ride; it’s your ticket to banter, camaraderie, and a good ol’ time! Our leaders will guide you, sharing pacing tips and tricks along the way. Remember, teamwork makes the dream work, so use that draft to your advantage as you barrel through the ride together!

A couple of quick housekeeping notes: we’re keeping the atmosphere all-inclusive and relaxed, with a focus on enjoyment rather than perfection. Sweeps and Ride Buddies will be off-duty this time, so if you find yourself lagging behind, feel free to continue at your own pace or buddy up with fellow riders nearby.

And hey, we’ve got a little rule: leave the TT Bikes at home! They don’t draft well and might make you puff and pant a bit more than you want. Mountain bikes? They’re welcome too, just be prepared to push a little harder than the folks on road bikes. No worries if you hit a snag; our 30-minute late join feature will let you teleport back to the main group with the magical YELLOW BEACON!

We’re all about chatting and having fun while we ride, so don’t miss out on our dedicated Discord channel! Join us, choose your pace, and get ready to share the laughs as we roll.

**Top Tips for Wacky Chase Success:**

1. Stick close to your ride leader; don’t let that gap turn into a canyon!

2. Avoid the fence—we want you in one piece, not fried!

3. Most importantly… HAVE FUN! This is all about the adventure.

Don’t forget to connect with us on our ZZRC Facebook page and join the club on the companion app for all the latest gossip and rides!

So get your cycling gear on, bring your best vibes, and let’s hit the Zwift Roads together!

Discord Channel

https://discord.com/channels/1009379476041383946/1009388181269004289
